g.id, g.user_id, g.source_approval_id, g.bundle_id, g.effective_time, g.expiration_time, g.end_reason, g.end_by, g.end_note, r.name as bundle_name
mapper.select: select g.bundle_id as bundleId, r.name as bundleName, max(g.id) as grantId, max(g.source_approval_id) as sourceApprovalId, min(g.effective_time) as effectiveTime, case when max(case when g.expiration_time is null then 1 else 0 end) = 1 then null else max(g.expiration_time) end as expirationTime, (select coalesce(sum( greatest(json_length(res.catalog_names), 1) * greatest(json_length(res.database_names), 1) * greatest(json_length(res.table_names), 1) * greatest(json_length(res.column_names), 1)), 0) from t_r_data_perm_bundle_statement b join t_r_data_perm_bundle_statement_resource res on res.statement_id = b.id where b.bundle_id = g.bundle_id) as permCount from t_r_data_perm_user_bundle_grant g left join t_r_data_perm_bundle r on r.id = g.bundle_id where g.user_id = #{userId} and g.effective_time <= #{asOf} and (g.expiration_time is null or g.expiration_time > #{asOf}) group by g.bundle_id, r.name order by min(g.effective_time)

mapper.update: update t_r_data_perm_user_bundle_grant set expiration_time = #{now}, end_reason = #{endReason}, end_by = #{endBy}, end_note = #{endNote} where id = #{id} and expiration_time is null
